issues.detail: Hebrew 'אַלּוּפֵינוּ' means 'our herds/oxen' (or 'our chiefs'), not 'our cows' (bò cái). The Vietnamese adds 'mang thai và đẻ nhiều' (pregnant and give birth abundantly) which is not in the Hebrew; the Hebrew simply says 'our herds are well-laden/burdened' (מְסֻבָּלִים), i.e., heavy-laden or numerous, not specifically pregnant or giving birth.
